capability.summary: Detect the probable character encoding of one local file
capability.description: Reads one local file as raw bytes and passes the complete byte sequence to chardet.detect, returning probable encoding, confidence, and language metadata.
capability.problem_space: Encoding inference for one existing local file; identifies a likely codec but does not transcode or decode the file.

constraint.io_signature: Input: one local file path; output: JSON object containing the path and chardet detection metadata under result.
accepted_inputs: an existing readable local file path
binary or text files whose raw bytes can be sampled by chardet
constraint.output_shape: Success is an object with status="success", tool="lib.chardet_detect", file as the input path string, and result as chardet's detection object containing encoding, confidence, and language keys. A caught file-read or detection exception produces an object with status="error", tool="lib.chardet_detect", and message as the exception string, then exits with code 1.
limitations: does not decode or rewrite file contents
reads the entire file into memory before detection
encoding detection is probabilistic and may be uncertain for short or mixed-encoding files

output_contract.description: Probable encoding and confidence metadata for one local file.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: detect the encoding of a local file
identify a probable charset from file bytes
negative_intents: convert a file from one encoding to another
